skill.name: Null Sphere
skill.description: Kassadin fires an orb of void energy at a target, dealing damage and interrupting channels. The excess energy forms around himself, granting a temporary shield that absorbs magic damage.

skill.name: Nether Blade
skill.description: Passive: Kassadin's basic attacks deal bonus magic damage. Active: Kassadin's next basic attack deals significant bonus magic damage and restores Mana.

skill.name: Super Scorcher Breath
skill.description: Smolder breathes fire on an enemy. As he gains more stacks, this ability becomes more powerful.

skill.name: MMOOOMMMM!
skill.description: Smolder calls his mom to breath fire from above, dealing extra damage and slowing enemies in the center of her fire.

passive.name: Dragon Practice
passive.description: Hitting champions with Abilities and killing enemies with Super Scorcher Breath grants a stack of Dragon Practice. Stacks increase the damage of Smolders basic Abilities.

skill.name: Pale Cascade
skill.description: Diana creates three orbiting spheres that detonate on contact with enemies to deal damage in an area. She also gains a temporary shield that absorbs damage. If her third sphere detonates, the shield gains additional strength.

passive.name: Z-Drive Resonance
passive.description: Every third attack or damaging spell on the same target deals bonus magic damage, and grants Ekko a burst of speed if the target is a champion.

skill.name: H-28 G Evolution Turret
skill.description: Heimerdinger lays down a rapid-fire cannon turret equipped with a secondary pass-through beam attack (turrets deal half damage to towers).

skill.name: CH-2 Electron Storm Grenade
skill.description: Heimerdinger lobs a grenade at a location, dealing damage to enemy units, as well as stunning anyone directly hit and slowing surrounding units.

passive.name: Harrier
passive.description: Valor, Quinn's Demacian eagle, periodically marks enemies with <keywordMajor>Harrier</keywordMajor>. Quinn's first basic attack against <keywordMajor>Harrier</keywordMajor> targets will deal bonus physical damage.

skill.name: Blinding Assault
skill.description: Quinn calls Valor to mark an enemy and hinder its vision before damaging all enemies in the immediate area.

skill.name: Toxic Shot
skill.description: Each of Teemo's attacks will poison the target %i:OnHit% <OnHit>On-Hit</OnHit>, dealing damage on impact and each second after for 4 seconds.

passive.name: Determination
passive.description: Every third attack deals bonus damage and heals Xin Zhao.
